about: Mira's accuracy test (evals/run.js). Every right answer was worked out with SQL directly against the LOCAL COPY (org 63, Alpine Test School), never through Mira's tools - see each question's `source`. `must`: facts that must appear (a list inside means any one of them). `mustNot`: facts that must not appear. `expect`: answer | preview | refuse | not_found | link. Questions with the same `chat` run in one chat, in order. Worked out 2026-11-23.
